decisionReason: Local isolated proof is strong, but hosted, canonical, ResourceSpace, Google Drive custody, durable state, and tester approval gates remain unproven.

localOperationalFollowUps.currentSignal: local free disk at least 10 GiB
localOperationalFollowUps.safeNextStep: Continue running make safe-lane-headroom-guard before heavy local work. If low disk recurs, use make safe-lane-disk-report, then clean only safe isolated build/runtime artifacts if needed; never clean shared checkout, source media, prod/hosted surfaces, or evidence artifacts without replacement proof. safe isolated cleanup may not be enough for default 10 GiB headroom when low disk recurs. Lowering SAFE_LANE_MIN_FREE_GIB for a focused safe command requires SAFE_LANE_HEADROOM_OVERRIDE_REASON.
